name: Forno Acqua AcquaFALL Mini Polished Chrome Retrofit Shower System 1.8 GPM
shortDescription: Upgrade even the smallest bathroom into a personal spa with the FORNO ACQUA Mini AcquaSPA Shower System. Perfect for apartments, guest suites, or compact layouts, this sleek 3-in-1 design features an oversized 9inch rain shower head for full-body coverage, a 5-function ergonomic handheld, and a revolutionary 10-1/2 in. AcquaFALL Waterfall Jet for soothing flow or targeted relief. The adjustable jet accommodates users of all heights for customized comfort. With a water-efficient 1.8 GPM flow rate, it helps conserve water without sacrificing performance. Quick DIY wall-mounted installation works with standard plumbing. Finished in polished chrome, the Mini AcquaSPA delivers modern style and spa-inspired luxury in a compact form.

features.text: Soothing 9 in. Oversized Rain Shower Head for Immersive Body Experience: Rain-like spray for everyday relaxation
5-Function Handheld Shower with 60" Hose for Targeted Relief: Ergonomic handheld sprayer includes Rain, Massage, Pulse and Combo functions.

3 AcquaSPA Adjustable, Directional Body Jets are Precisely Spaced for True Full-Body Relief: Experience targeted relief for upper, mid, and lower muscle zones, customized spa-quality comfort for every body
Easy DIY Installation with Existing Plumbing on Flat or Uneven Surfaces: Fits standard plumbing, quick, no-fuss at-home installation
6-Way Diverter Offers Full Control of Shower Functions: Switch with ease; rain shower, handheld, or jets. Mix and match for a custom spa feel.
Integrated Sliding Bar with Adjustable Holder for Handheld Flexibility: Adjustable handheld shower, custom height and angle for easier use by children, seniors, and every family member.
